summary.text: Shelley Rudnicki is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives for House District 67, representing Benton and Fairfield.
The page lists Shelley Rudnicki as ranking member of the Taxation committee.

paragraphs.text: The page lists Shelley Rudnicki's occupation as Business Owner.
Listed affiliations include Victor Grange, Order of Eastern Star, Elks Club.
Shelley Rudnicki lives in Fairfield and has served 4 sessions in the House, most recently the 132nd Legislature.
Family details on the page: married, spouse Anthony, 2 children.
